name: Sets and Set Operations
explanation: A set is a well-defined collection of distinct objects. Operations include union (A∪B), intersection (A∩B), difference (A−B), and complement (A'). For IOE, focus on 3-set Venn diagram problems.
examTip: Practice 3-set Venn diagram word problems. They appear every year in IOE mathematics.

name: Real Number System
explanation: The real number system includes natural numbers, integers, rationals, irrationals, and reals. Understanding intervals and absolute value properties is essential.
examTip: Know the hierarchy of number sets and interval notation thoroughly.

name: Quadratic Equations
explanation: A quadratic equation ax²+bx+c=0 has solutions given by the quadratic formula. The discriminant determines the nature of roots.
examTip: If roots are α and β, the equation with roots α² and β² uses α²+β² = (α+β)²−2αβ.

name: Arithmetic and Geometric Progressions
explanation: AP: a, a+d, a+2d... GP: a, ar, ar²... Sum formulas and convergence of infinite GP are frequently tested.
examTip: Infinite GP sum formula is tested almost every year. Know convergence conditions.

name: Matrix Operations and Types
explanation: Matrices are rectangular arrays of numbers. Key operations include addition, scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication, and transpose.
keyPoints: Matrix multiplication AB ≠ BA in general
examTip: Matrix multiplication order matters. Practice 3x3 multiplication for speed.

name: Newton's Laws of Motion
explanation: Three fundamental laws governing motion of objects. Focus on free body diagrams, friction, and inclined plane problems.
examTip: Always draw free body diagrams. Most errors come from incorrect force resolution.

name: Work, Energy, and Power
explanation: Work-energy theorem connects force and displacement. Conservation of energy is a powerful problem-solving tool.
examTip: Use energy conservation instead of kinematics equations when possible—it's faster and less error-prone.

name: Atomic Structure
explanation: Covers Bohr's model, quantum numbers, electronic configuration, and Aufbau principle.
keyPoints: Four quantum numbers: n, l, ml, ms
Aufbau principle, Hund's rule, Pauli exclusion
examTip: Know electronic configurations of transition elements and their exceptions (Cr, Cu).

name: Set Notation and Operations
explanation: Basic set concepts including roster and set-builder notation, universal set, subsets, and basic operations.
examTip: Always identify the universal set first in word problems.

name: Venn Diagrams
explanation: Visual representation of set operations using overlapping circles. SEE commonly tests 2-set problems.
examTip: Start from the intersection region and work outward when solving Venn diagram problems.
